void transfer(Users* sender, vector<Users>& accounts) {
    clearConsole(); // clear screen for transfer UI
    string receiverName; // target username
    double amt; // amount to transfer

    cout << "TRANSFER MONEY" << endl; // header
    cout << "Total Balance: " << fixed << setprecision(2) << sender->balance << "\n\n"; // show sender balance

    cout << "Send to (Username): ";
    getline(cin >> ws, receiverName); // use >> ws to skip whitespace and read username

    cout << "Amount: ";
    if (!(cin >> amt)) { // validate numeric input
        cin.clear(); // clear error state
        cin.ignore(numeric_limits<streamsize>::max(), '\n'); // discard invalid input
        inverror(); // invalid amount handler
        return; // abort transfer
    }

    if (amt <= 0) {
        inverror(); // invalid amount handler
        return; // abort transfer
    }
    if (amt > sender->balance) {
        inserror(); // insufficient funds handler
        return; // abort transfer
    }

    Users* receiver = nullptr; // pointer to found receiver
    for (auto &u : accounts) {
        if (u.userName == receiverName) {
            receiver = &u; // assign receiver pointer when found
            break; // stop searching
        }
    }

    if (receiver == nullptr) {
        cout << "User not Found!\n\n"; // notify if username doesn't exist
        system("pause"); // wait for user
        return; // abort transfer
    }

    sender->balance -= amt; // deduct from sender
    receiver->balance += amt; // add to receiver
    saveAccounts(accounts); // persist updated balances

    cout << "Transfer Successful!" << endl; // success message
    cout << "Total Balance: " << fixed << setprecision(2) << sender->balance << endl; // show sender new balance

    Transaction t1{sender->userName, "Transfer", amt, getDate()}; // sender transaction record
    writeTransaction(t1); // write sender transaction

    Transaction t2{receiver->userName, "Receive", amt, getDate()}; // receiver transaction record
    writeTransaction(t2); // write receiver transaction

    system("pause"); // wait for user
}
